statements.status_notes: CVE-2026-41185 is an insertion of sensitive information into log files in Project Calico. Upstream fixed the issue in Calico v3.31.6. The 3.30.x release line has no backported fix; v3.30.7 is the latest 3.30 tag and remains in the affected range. Consumers on the 3.30 track must upgrade to 3.31.6 or later, or wait for an upstream 3.30.x security release.
